evidence.title: Agility Robotics Announces Audit Committee Chair for Planned Public-Company Board
evidence.excerpt: SALEM, Ore. and NEW YORK, N.Y., Oct. 19, 2026 — Agility Robotics , a leading humanoid robotics and physical AI company, today announced that Mark Vale, CEO and board member at Transportation Insight and a former president of UPS, is expected to join its board of directors and chair its audit committee following completion of its previously announced business combination with Churchill Capital Corp XI (NASDAQ: CCXI) (“Churchill XI”). The appointment will bring additional experience in global logistics, financial oversight and strategic investment as Agility expands customer deployments of Digit®, scales manufacturing and prepares to operate as a public company. “Scaling humanoid robotics requires a deep understanding of our customers’ operations and the financial discipline to build a durable global business,” said Peggy Johnson, CEO of Agility Robotics. “Mark brings both, drawing on more than three decades of leadership across logistics and finance.
